ideas.title: The Web of Deceit: Uncovering Minnesota's $90M Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the $90 million Medicaid fraud schemes in Minnesota, including the 15 defendants charged and potential connections to other entities
questions: What are the connections between entities?
How did the fraud schemes operate?
ideas.insight: This story could uncover a large-scale fraud network and potentially lead to more charges and convictions

ideas.title: Aimee Bock's Downfall: The Feeding Our Future Scandal
ideas.description: Investigate Aimee Bock's role in the $250M Feeding Our Future fraud and her 41-year prison sentence
ideas.insight: This story could provide insight into the inner workings of the Feeding Our Future organization and Bock's culpability
